item.title: The Lobby Shop- Setting the Table for 2026- Tariffs, Messaging and the Midterm Map [Podcast]
item.description: Kicking off the first The Lobby Shop episode of 2026, hosts Josh Zive, Caitlin Sickles, Dylan Pasiuk, and Liam Donovan take stock of the political forces already shaping the year ahead. The conversation spans looming Supreme Court decisions on IEEPA tariffs, the communications challenges facing parties heading into a midterm year, and what recent elections signal for House and Senate control. item.title: Your Proposition 65 2025 “Wrapped”- 2025 Year in Review

item.title: Important Guidance for Employers Strategizing H-1B Cap Registration & Filing
item.description: Multiple significant changes to the H-1B program occurred in 2025. For employers, planning for the impacts of these changes is crucial. item.description: As the Supreme Court prepares its docket for the New Year, Richards v. item.title: Federal Court Orders CFPB to Continue Requesting Funding Operations Amid Defunding Dispute
item.description: On December 30, the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia ordered that the CFPB must continue requesting funding from the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System under the statutory funding framework established by Congress. item.title: Baltimore Sues Fintech for Alleged Unfair and Deceptive Cash-Advance Practices
item.description: On December 30, Baltimore Mayor Brandon M. Scott announced that the City of Baltimore filed a civil action against a fintech provider offering small-dollar cash advance products, alleging violations of the Baltimore Consumer Protection Ordinance. According to the City, the fintech’s cash-advance product that was promoted as an earned wage access or overdraft-style service but allegedly imposed costs that far exceeded Maryland’s 33 percent interest-rate cap for consumer loans. item.title: California DFPI Sets March 15, 2026 Deadline for Commercial Financing Annual Reports
